title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt, beauty, complicity; durable and humane.

title: La La Land
note: Lush musical homage; emotionally affecting but thematically modest, divisive among cinephiles.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar; humane class drama; endlessly rewatchable.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Restraint as form; indelible mood, longing, color; deepens on rewatch.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory; brilliant tonal control; broadly admired, mildly debated.

title: City Lights
note: Silent comedy-pathos; the final shot indelible; near-perfect emotional craft.

title: Spirited Away
note: Boundless imaginative world; animation as vision; rich, rewatchable, humane.

title: The Godfather
note: American tragedy of power and family; majestic craft; inexhaustible.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Single-room moral procedural; conviction and doubt; somewhat schematic but durable.

title: A Separation
note: Ethical truth told from every side; superb realist moral complexity.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze, memory, art as love; composed and intelligent; lingers.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender triptych on identity and tenderness; sensuous form; deeply felt.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual shift on time, evolution, cosmos; formally radical; lifetime object.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic grief and grace; rapturous form; sharply divides serious viewers.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic deconstruction of Hollywood; reorganizes how you read film; inexhaustible.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Life as theater of death; staggering ambition; bleak and divisive.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Duration as feminist form; reconceives time and domestic labor; endurance-testing.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief, nature, misogyny debate; striking imagery; provocation splits viewers hard.

title: Holy Motors
note: Cinema-as-performance elegy; protean invention; demanding, gloriously strange.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Anxiety as form; relentless craft; thin morally but viscerally durable.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Anxious Oedipal odyssey; ambitious sprawl; indulgent, fiercely polarizing.

title: Close-Up
note: Reality/fiction collapse on cinema and identity; profound, deceptively simple, durable.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread, control allegory; atmospheric puzzle; rewards but slightly hollow.

title: Climax
note: Bodily descent into chaos; bravura camera; sensation over substance, divisive.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur blockbuster; perverse design; tonally bold, uneven, cult-divisive.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Peerless practical spectacle; emotionally efficient; nostalgic, ideologically tidy crowd-pleaser.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless caper craft; cool and clever; consciously slight, hugely rewatchable.

title: Ant-Man
note: Pleasant formula heist; competent and forgettable; franchise-safe, minimal durable value.

title: John Wick
note: Action choreography as clean craft; world-built mythos; stylish, thematically thin.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy rom-com with representation milestone; conventional craft; pleasant, commercially safe.

title: The Hangover
note: Effective comedy engine; crude and disposable; little durable cinematic value.

title: Jurassic World
note: Self-aware franchise reboot; spectacle-driven; hollow, nostalgic, commercially cynical.

title: Knives Out
note: Smart genre revival with class satire; clever, well-built, satisfying not profound.

title: The Intouchables
note: Crowd-pleasing odd-couple uplift; warm but sentimental; racial-dynamics critique divides.

title: Free Guy
note: Affable meta-game comedy; product-laden and safe; pleasant, thin, corporate.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist ode to cinema's chaos; dazzling and excessive; sharply divides.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Ambitious interwoven souls-across-time epic; earnest sprawl; structurally bold, deeply divisive.

title: The Counselor
note: McCarthy's nihilist fable on greed and consequence; talky, bleak, fiercely reappraised.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; committed lead; derivative provocation, violently debated.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; urgent topic, smug execution; preachy, polarizing, shallow.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Subversive franchise entry; striking imagery, thematic risk; legendarily divides fandom.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Hyperstylized empowerment-or-exploitation muddle; flashy, incoherent; intentions hotly disputed.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon American-dream satire; hypnotic editing; critique-or-complicity debate splits viewers sharply.

title: The Fountain
note: Mortality across three timelines; visually ambitious; earnest, overreaching, polarizing.

title: Southland Tales
note: Apocalyptic millennial chaos; overstuffed prophecy; messy cult object, deeply divisive.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Studio-mangled antihero romp; incoherent tone; hollow, focus-tested, widely panned.

title: Vox Lux
note: Pop-stardom-and-trauma allegory; formally daring; cold, ambitious, sharply divides.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Technical-immersion landmark; thin story, ecological earnestness; spectacle over substance.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Buoyant jukebox confection; technically rough; pure pleasure, negligible durable value.

title: Now You See Me
note: Slick magician caper; flashy misdirection; clever surface, hollow and disposable.
